verdict.line: You win this if you cash in your Q stun and solo-kill lead before level 6; you lose it if the lane drags into a slow midgame where his Living Forge gold starts outscaling you.

brief.thesis: Tahm Kench's Q (Tongue Lash) poke and the An Acquired Taste stun give him a clean, repeatable way to force a kill before Ornn's R (Call of the Forge God) comes online at level 6 — that's exactly where the measured lane and solo-kill advantage come from. Once Ornn hits 6 and starts forging extra resistances through Living Forge, the matchup flattens out, which is why the head-to-head win rate (47.2% over 193 games) sits below Tahm's matchup-wide average (50.7% over 17,962 games) even with the early edge.

theirWindow.what: His R (Call of the Forge God, CD 140/120/100/100/100s, range 2500) sends an elemental at you that slows and Brittles anything it runs over, and he can recast it to redirect a knockup into you. Stay off the exact lane terrain he can charge the elemental through, and don't trade down low once he's 6, since a follow-up E (Searing Charge, range 450, CD 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) shockwave can combo off it if you're caught near a wall.

yourWindow.what: Land Q (Tongue Lash, range 900, CD 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s) repeatedly to slow him, heal yourself, and stack An Acquired Taste; the third stack means your next Q stuns him outright. Dive on the stun with W (Abyssal Dive, range 1000, CD 21/20/19/18/17s) and autos — he has no dash of his own until E is up, so this is a clean, low-risk all-in window.

start.why: Measured as the dominant start (48.3% win over 178 games, 74.2% pick) — the regen and block vs autos let you tank his Q (Volcanic Rupture) poke while you out-trade him with Q.

boots.why: Highest measured win rate on boots (53.4% over 58 games) — the flat damage reduction cuts down his auto-attack and E (Searing Charge) collision damage better than tenacity does in a lane he already struggles to kite you in.

core.why: Stacks bonus max health, which directly scales your passive's bonus damage and the shield you get off E (Thick Skin).
Measured core follow-up on this build path (part of the 64.3% win-rate line over 14 games) — mixed resistances keep you alive against his magic-and-physical hybrid kit.
Amplifies the healing from Thick Skin and from Devour, and adds magic resist against his Q/R magic damage — the top-performing third item on record (64.3% over 14 games).

situational.when: their team leans on sustained auto-attack damage and you need the grievous wounds and armor more than raw health
you need more personal kill pressure to actually close out solo kills instead of just surviving them
you're snowballing off your early solo-kill lead and want to convert it into a bigger stat advantage faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the exact trade pattern this matchup wants — poking with Q and holding max health in melee range — and the highest-sampled page on record (53.8% win, 45.7% pick) runs it.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the clear measured outperformer here (59.7% win, 31.1% pick) over Flash+Ignite (43.5%) — your kill pressure comes from the Q-stack stun and W dive, not a flat burst spell, so Teleport's tempo and plating value matters more than Ignite's secure.

playing.title: Poke before you all-in
playing.detail: Throw Q (Tongue Lash, range 900, CD 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s) at max range every time it's up before level 6 — each hit slows, heals you, and stacks An Acquired Taste toward the stun.

playing.title: Dive on the third stack
playing.detail: Once Ornn has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, your next Q stuns him and consumes the stacks — follow it immediately with W (Abyssal Dive, range 1000, CD 21-17s) and autos while he's locked down.

playing.title: Fight him away from walls
playing.detail: His E (Searing Charge, range 450, CD 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) only produces a knockup shockwave if he collides with terrain mid-charge — stay in open lane space so a whiffed E just burns his cooldown.

playing.title: Bank Thick Skin before his pokes
playing.detail: E (Thick Skin, CD 3s) stores damage you take and heals you from it out of combat; pop the active shield right before he lands Q (Volcanic Rupture, range 800, CD 9-7s) so you absorb it instead of eating it raw.

playing.title: Respect level 6 positioning
playing.detail: His R (Call of the Forge God, CD 140/120/100/100/100s, range 2500) sends an elemental that slows and Brittles anything it hits, and he can recast it to knock you up — don't stand in its travel path or near walls once he's 6.

playing.title: Save Devour for isolated picks
playing.detail: R (Devour, 0s cooldown) only lands on an enemy champion once your passive has 3 stacks on him — use it to swallow him when he's split from his jungler, since it deals magic damage and removes him from the fight outright.

playing.title: Convert the lead into tempo
playing.detail: His Living Forge passive gives him free bonus resistances and lets him forge items for gold efficiency as the game goes long, so push your early solo-kill advantage into plates and objectives rather than grinding extended trades past level 8.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled directly from measured Tahm Kench vs Ornn games on the current patch (op.gg); the tactical reasoning — trade timing, Brittle/R windows, and wave management — is our own read of the kit, not sourced from that aggregate data.

stats.opponentTip: Although Ornn can deal a lot of damage to tanks, use [Q] and [W] accordingly to get a kill. Try to use [Q] to close in and deal damage from level 1. Be careful of being killed by his (R) if you failed to manage your health properly after reaching level 6.
